text: Dzień dobry, w mieszkaniu jest pleśń na ścianie w sypialni, coraz gorzej, dziecko ma astmę. Mieszkanie 9, Beechwood House. Dziękuję.
notes: Client message 5 (Polish: 'there is mould on the bedroom wall, getting worse, the child has asthma'). Two photos attached in the original; photos are not read (D14). Damp/mould goes to Unsure (D5). Not a rule emergency; worsening mould with an asthmatic child should not wait five days, so Urgent. Child with asthma = vulnerability.
